requirements.text: * B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science or equivalent.
* 2\+ years of industry experience building web applications end\-to\-end, using TypeScript with React on the frontend.
* Exceptionally strong knowledge of CS fundamental concepts and OOP languages.
* Deep understanding of REST/gRPC principles and experience designing, implementing, and consuming backend APIs.
* Great understanding of database technologies and choosing the right kind of storage layers for the problem at hand.
* Backend experience with Java, Kotlin, Python, or Go.
* Experience with documentation, unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing across frontend and backend.
* A product mindset that you apply to how you build platform services and user\-facing tools.
* Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) across the full software development lifecycle, including design, code generation, testing, monitoring, and release.
* Experience building internal tools, admin consoles, or developer platforms used across many teams.
* Prior experience with the nuanced world of Experiment configurations and feature flagging products.
* Experience with any of the "Big Data" technologies (e.g., Postgres, Redis, Elasticsearch, Snowflake, Mode, Segment, Spark, etc.).
* Experience in any data\-science related subjects such as analytics, statistics, machine learning, etc.
Familiarity with cloud\-based environments such as AWS.
